§6Boiler: Oil Refining§f

§aCrude oil needs to hit §e350°C§f before the refinery can touch it. This machine does that.§f

The Boiler heats fluids using an external heat source like a §bFirebox§f. For oil processing, you need to convert §bCrude Oil§f into §bHot Crude Oil§f before feeding it to the §bOil Refinery§f.

§6Setup§f:
Place a §bFirebox§f underneath, then the boiler on top. §9Right-click§f the boiler with a §bFluid Identifier§f to select which fluid to heat. Defaults to water.
§b• Input tank§f: §e16,000mB§f
§b• Heat transfer§f: §eΔT × 0.01 TU/t§f
§b• Ducts§f: Three connections (top, two sides)

Crafted on a §bTier 2 Anvil§f with §e4× Steel Ingot§f, §e16× Copper Plate§f, §e8× Insulator§f.

§cWARNING:§f The boiler §cexplodes§f if the output tank overflows. Watch your fluid levels. The §bIndustrial Boiler§f does not explode.

§ePS:§f Many setups use a §bFluid Burner§f burning §bHeating Oil§f to heat the boiler, making the system self-sustaining.
